QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_PRIVATE` is a name-mangling macro... `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member` ... in a default build the field is really named `private_state`... every library `.c` that includes `common.h` sees plain field names... `ssl_server2.c` ... define the macro before any include, so they get plain names."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both expansions and says that code defining the macro sees plain names while ordinary external consumers see the `private_`-prefixed names.
